svg.title: The rock cycle
svg.desc: A side-on landscape of the rock cycle: magma cools to form igneous rock (basalt from lava, granite underground), rock is weathered and eroded, a river carries sediment to the sea where deposition, compaction and cementation make sedimentary rock, heat and pressure turn buried rock into metamorphic rock, and melting turns it back into magma.

g.text: Rock is broken down and carried away
